description: 飼料油品輸入登記證 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供資料包含：登記證證號、登記證類別、商號代碼、商號名稱、工廠名稱、工廠地址、負責人姓名、飼料品目類別、飼料品目、商品名稱、適用對象、包裝型式、形狀、成分、核發日期、有效日期等欄位資料。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2026-03-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
